# Appendix map

| Appendix | Function | Supports |
|---|---|---|
| A — Typed definitions | domains, packages, profiles, recovery modes, indexed families | Sections 2--4 |
| B — Composition proofs | expectation-modulus composition and associativity | Proposition 3.5 |
| C — Spectral proofs | positive Laplace support lemma, central theorem, approximate variant | Theorem 4.2; Corollary 4.3 |
| D — Countermodel details | hidden sector, collapsing gaps, limit-order defect | Section 5; supplement |
| E — Yang--Mills certificate table | visibility, loss, recovery, and open obligations at every interface | Section 6 |
| F — Reproducibility | commands, trust boundary, and certificate scope | supplement and build artifacts |

The order is dependency-topological: typed objects precede composition;
composition precedes recovery; recovery precedes falsification and the
Yang--Mills application.
